thread.title: Apple Inc. (AAPL)’s self-driving test fleet rises from 3 to 27

author: Grant Pasek
title: Apple Inc. (AAPL)’s self-driving test fleet rises from 3 to 27
text:
January 25, 2018 Apple Inc. (AAPL)’s self-driving test fleet rises from 3 to 27 
Apple Inc. (AAPL) shares rose 0.37% in extended hours trade on Thursday. The self-driving car efforts are the part of Apple‘s future plans as it has reportedly increases the test fleet of autonomous car from 3 to 27, so it’s pretty clear that the tech giant is working on it. 
For a couple years now, it seem like Apple is bit quiet on self-driving cars, but originally, Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) wanted to build an entire vehicle, and this work is in progress under its top-secret Project named “Titan”. 
These future plans were scaled back, to a self-driving platform only, which Apple Inc. (AAPL) could develop and then sell to automakers, but the tech company don’t want to spend the time or money on developing their own platforms to get an competitive edge on others like Waymo and Uber, who are also doing the same. 
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s stock on Thursday traded at beginning with a price of $ 174.51 and when day-trade ended the stock finally plummeted -1.79% to reach at $171.11. Analyst’s mean target price for AAPL is $188.46 while analysts mean recommendation is 1.80. Stock value has moved between $120.5 – 180.12 in last one year. 
Once Apple’s name appeared there, it’d be hard for Apple to keep pretending Project Titan didn’t exist. That’s likely part of the reason why CEO Tim Cook broke the barrier of secrecy last June, when he admitted his company was working on an autonomous platform. The company is still more secretive than Uber or Waymo, but that could change as it continues with its development cycle. 
Analyst’s ratings play a very important role in outlining a stock’s performance. Let us check out how analysts have ranked AAPL based on current scenarios. Stock has got OUTPERFORM rating from 15 analyst(s) whereas last month 17 analyst(s) have given outperform rating. SELL rating has been given by 0 analyst(s) and 16 analyst(s) given BUY rating to the stock. Company fiscal year is ending in September and analysts’ consensus recommendation is Outperform for AAPL and estimated EPS for next quarter is 4.16. 
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) yearly performance is 45.22% and net profit margin is 21.10%. Annual EPS Growth of past 5 years is 7.90%. The current share price indicates that stock is -3.26% away from its one year high and is moving 45.79% ahead of its 52-week low. About Grant Pasek
